Date: 2026-08-18
Tail-Risk Brief v2.0 — Morning Desk Section (pre-market America/Chicago)

# Section 0: Current Positions & Hypotheses

As of August 18, 2026 (pre-market, ~8:30 AM CT). Research framework, not trade recommendations.

**Book snapshot (Agentic ••••770):** Cash 66.4% · net delta 36.8% · gross delta leverage 0.37× · premium at risk 4.6% · theta ~0%/day (all-long, deep-dated).
**Model risk appetite:** GPT 6/10 (Risk-on) · Grok 4/10 (Neutral) · Fable 8/10 (Risk-on) — engines split; Grok's defensive tilt is the outlier.

**Core positions (sized):** BRBR 500 sh @ $10.81 + 3× Jan '28 $12.50C · FRMI 500 sh @ $6.56 + 10× Dec '28 $10C · WAY 300 sh @ $24.60 + 1× Jan '27 $25C · AAON 50 sh @ $88.12 · CYPH 5× Mar '27 $0.50C. Trackers (1 sh): NKE, OSCR, BOT, HIMS, FIGR, URNM.

## 1. BRBR — branded protein recovery (hold)

**Price:** $10.19 close / $10.24 pre-market (+0.6%) | RSI(14): 36.4 | MACD histogram: -0.28
**Valuation:** Market cap $1.18B | PE 7.6× (depressed earnings) | 52w range $7.82–$43.02 | Beta vs SPY 0.34
**Entry levels (1Y low / Aug 12 close / 1Y high — market refs, not DCF):** Bear $7.90 | Base $10.85 | Bull $42.68
**Thesis:** Company-specific margin recovery, not a generic GLP-1 play. FQ3 sales +4.2% to $570.4M, Premier Protein RTD volume +3.1%, but adjusted gross margin fell to 27.7% from 35.1%. Pricing/productivity must restore margin without breaking demand.
**Holdings:** 500 sh @ $10.81 + 3× Jan 2028 $12.50 calls @ $3.80
**Latest:** FQ3 (Aug 4) EPS $0.30 vs $0.36 est — miss on margin compression. Diamond Hill disclosed a new BRBR position (Aug 17); Ameriprise reports 5.0% ownership with shared control (Aug 14).
**Catalyst:** FQ4 earnings — est. Nov 17, 2026 (unconfirmed)
**Kill watch:** Price $10.24 sits 5.6% below base $10.85; bear ref $7.90 is -22%. RSI 36.4 is second-weakest in book. Kill signal: volumes decelerating alongside failed margin recapture.
**Action:** Hold — best reference R/R in the book; margin evidence due at FQ4.

![BRBR RSI](charts/2026-08-18/brbr-rsi.png)

![BRBR MACD](charts/2026-08-18/brbr-macd.png)

## 2. MOS — fertilizer-cycle recovery (hold)

**Price:** $21.23 close / $21.14 pre-market (-0.4%) | RSI(14): 42.8 | MACD histogram: -0.13
**Valuation:** Market cap $6.75B | PE n/m (loss) | P/B 0.60× | Div yield 4.1% | 52w range $19.80–$37.00
**Entry levels (1Y low / Aug 12 close / 1Y high):** Bear $19.82 | Base $22.60 | Bull $31.04
**Thesis:** Potash resilience must offset weak phosphate economics. Q2: $2.8B revenue, $407M adj EBITDA, but $273M net loss and -$153M FCF. Lower output, costs, capex and working-capital release must become cash, not adjusted earnings.
**Holdings:** No position (hypothesis tracking only)
**Latest:** Q2 (Aug 4) EPS $0.13 vs $0.17 est — modest miss. Belarus potash-sanctions easing remains the key supply overhang; phosphate economics still weak.
**Catalyst:** Q3 earnings — Nov 3, 2026 pm (unconfirmed)
**Kill watch:** Price 6.5% below base, 6.7% above bear. P/B 0.6× + 4.1% yield floor the downside; cash conversion is the test.
**Action:** Watch — add on approach to $19.80–20.50 zone if potash pricing holds.

![MOS RSI](charts/2026-08-18/mos-rsi.png)

![MOS MACD](charts/2026-08-18/mos-macd.png)

## 3. FRMI — development-stage AI infrastructure (hold, high conviction risk)

**Price:** $6.14 close / $5.94 pre-market (-3.3%) | RSI(14): 47.9 | MACD histogram: +0.09 (turning up)
**Valuation:** Market cap $3.9B | P/B 3.96× | Pre-revenue | 52w range $4.47–$36.99 | Beta 1.76
**Entry levels (52w low / cost basis / call strike refs):** Bear $4.47 | Base $7.26 | Bull $15.00
**Thesis:** Project Matador becoming a scarce, gigawatt-scale powered AI campus near Amarillo. Commercial agreements and funded delivery — not headline capacity — must validate it.
**Holdings:** 500 sh @ $6.56 + 10× Dec 2028 $10 calls @ $3.676 (largest option position, 7.2% exposure)
**Latest:** Claimed AI campus will use 80% less water than conventional cooling (Jun 24). Overhang history: CEO exit (Apr), insider selling reports (Apr), Barron's structural critique (Mar). Energy-demand signals from SpaceX-adjacent Texas load support the thesis.
**Catalyst:** Post-Q2 construction milestones; customer/power agreements TBD
**Kill watch:** Price 18% below base $7.26; bear ref $4.47 is -25%. MACD histogram just flipped positive — only early-momentum signal in the weak side of the book.
**Action:** Hold — binary; keep size contained, watch for funded-delivery evidence.

![FRMI RSI](charts/2026-08-18/frmi-rsi.png)

![FRMI MACD](charts/2026-08-18/frmi-macd.png)

## 4. WAY — healthcare-payment software (hold)

**Price:** $24.68 close / ~$24.90 pre-market (+0.9%, wide 22.98/24.99 market) | RSI(14): 59.1 | MACD histogram: +0.10
**Valuation:** Market cap $4.73B | PE 35.3× | P/B 1.19× | 52w range $17.26–$41.47
**Entry levels (1Y low / Aug 13 close / 1Y high):** Bear $17.31 | Base $25.08 | Bull $40.89
**Thesis:** Subscription compounder: Q2 revenue +18% to $319.7M, subscription revenue +34%, NRR 108%, 43% adj EBITDA margin. Needs recurring cash conversion and durable organic growth without leverage drag.
**Holdings:** 300 sh @ $24.60 + 1× Jan 2027 $25 call @ $3.50 (300 sh currently held-for-sells)
**Latest:** Q2 (Jul 29) EPS $0.43 vs $0.39 est — beat, 6th beat in 8 quarters. Diamond Hill bought 2.11M shares (Aug 17). CEO Hawkins sold $2.06M stock (Aug 13). Zacks upgraded to Buy (Aug 3).
**Catalyst:** Q3 earnings — Oct 28, 2026 pm (unconfirmed)
**Kill watch:** Price pinned at base $25.08; RSI 59.1 = healthiest chart of the value side. Kill: NRR below 105% or subscription growth decelerating under 20%.
**Action:** Hold — strongest fundamentals-to-price alignment in the book.

![WAY RSI](charts/2026-08-18/way-rsi.png)

![WAY MACD](charts/2026-08-18/way-macd.png)

## 5. AAON — data-center cooling (hold, post-earnings)

**Price:** $88.09 close / $86.00 pre-market (-2.4%) | RSI(14): 36.5 | MACD histogram: +0.12
**Valuation:** Market cap $7.27B | PE 45.9× | Div yield 0.5% | 52w range $73.19–$150.46
**Entry levels (52W low / Aug 13 close / 52W high):** Bear $71.77 | Base $87.67 | Bull $148.15
**Thesis:** BASX cooling demand and $2.0B record backlog must convert into revenue, gross-margin recovery, and cash faster than Memphis overhead ramps.
**Holdings:** 50 sh @ $88.12
**Latest:** Q2 (Aug 10) EPS $0.69 vs $0.50 est — 38% beat; revenue +101% YoY; "data-center cooling demand surges" (Seeking Alpha). Oppenheimer reiterated Outperform. Counterpoint: simplywall.st flags margin-reset risk after breakneck growth.
**Catalyst:** Q3 earnings — Nov 5, 2026 am (unconfirmed)
**Kill watch:** Pre-market -2.4% giving back beat gains; RSI 36.5 weakest in book. Price 1.9% below base. Kill: backlog conversion stalling or gross margin declining again.
**Action:** Hold — beat confirmed demand; fade weakness toward $82–84 only if margin narrative holds.

![AAON RSI](charts/2026-08-18/aaon-rsi.png)

![AAON MACD](charts/2026-08-18/aaon-macd.png)

## 6. NKE — brand turnaround (tracker; range broken)

**Price:** $39.09 close / $39.54 pre-market (+1.2%) | RSI(14): 42.1 | MACD histogram: -0.12
**Valuation:** Market cap $58.0B | PE 18.6× | Div yield 4.2% | 52w range $38.86–$80.17
**Entry levels (52W low / Aug 14 close / 52W high):** Bear $40.51 | Base $40.73 | Bull $77.06
**Thesis:** Wholesale growth and performance-product traction must become durable revenue and margin recovery while NIKE Direct, Greater China, and inventory stay weak. FY26 revenue flat at $46.4B.
**Holdings:** 1 sh @ $40.85 (tracker)
**Latest:** Stock at 12-year lows — 12th consecutive down leg; -50.7% over two years, ~-80% over five. Seeking Alpha (Aug 18): "not yet oversold." Yesterday's $38.86 low breached the Aug-14 bear reference — the reference range is broken, so entry levels are being rebuilt at the Sep 8 checkpoint.
**Catalyst:** Hypothesis checkpoint — Sep 8, 2026 (confirmed) · FY27 Q1 earnings — Sep 29 pm (unconfirmed)
**Kill watch:** Trading below all reference levels. Dividend yield 4.2% is the only floor signal; another guidance cut at Sep 29 earnings likely re-rates to $30s mid.
**Action:** Track only — do not average down until wholesale/China data inflect.

![NKE RSI](charts/2026-08-18/nke-rsi.png)

![NKE MACD](charts/2026-08-18/nke-macd.png)

## 7. OSCR — ACA scale and operating leverage (tracker, momentum leader)

**Price:** $31.55 close / $31.32 pre-market (-0.7%) | RSI(14): 62.1 | MACD histogram: +0.13
**Valuation:** Market cap $9.74B | PE 23.9× | 52w range $10.69–$33.27 (high hit Aug 14)
**Entry levels (52W low / Aug 17 close / 52W high):** Bear $10.85 | Base $31.55 | Bull $32.76
**Thesis:** Membership 2.96M and MLR 79.2% show the individual-market platform scaling; the real test is 2027 pricing under subsidy expiration and program-integrity rules.
**Holdings:** 1 sh @ $31.34 (tracker)
**Latest:** Q2 (Aug 6) EPS $1.10 vs $0.32 est — blowout; swung to profit and raised 2026 guidance; +17.4% since. GuruFocus still flags overvaluation (GF 82/100); IBD flags H2 medical-cost risk.
**Catalyst:** Q3 earnings — Nov 5, 2026 am (unconfirmed)
**Kill watch:** RSI 62.1 = strongest momentum in book, but price sits within 1.5% of the 52W high — reference upside is nearly exhausted. Pullback risk into Sep/Oct rate-cycle news.
**Action:** Track — momentum valid; entry R/R poor until a base forms above $28.

![OSCR RSI](charts/2026-08-18/oscr-rsi.png)

![OSCR MACD](charts/2026-08-18/oscr-macd.png)

## Mini-book (trackers & options-only)

- **CYPH** — 5× Mar '27 $0.50C @ $0.40. Zcash-treasury + oncology option; holds 323,394 ZEC (~1.92% of supply) as of Aug 11. Pre-market $0.73, +3.5% — best mover this morning. Q2 profit was mark-to-market, not operations.
- **BOT** — 1 sh @ $32.67. Closed-end private-robotics access; June 22 NAV $8.92 vs ~$30.29 pre-market (-6.8% today) — premium-to-NAV is the whole risk. Aug 30 NAV checkpoint.
- **GRND** — no position. Q2 revenue +32.5% to $138.1M, 1.4M paying users, $57.6M adj EBITDA. Watch-only.
- **HIMS** — 1 sh @ $28.73, pre-market $27.97 (-2.3%). Post-PCAC peptide optionality still lacks an FDA timetable.
- **FIGR** — 1 sh @ $35.00 (filled yesterday), pre-market $34.41 (-3.8%). Blockchain lending marketplace; volatile tape.
- **URNM** — 1 sh @ $55.96, pre-market $54.79 (-1.4%). Uranium exposure; 52w range $43.56–$84.95.

## Risk/Reward ranking (reference levels: upside to bull ÷ downside to bear)

| Rank | Ticker | Price | Bear | Base | Bull | Ref R/R | Note |
|------|--------|-------|------|------|------|---------|------|
| 1 | BRBR | $10.24 | $7.90 | $10.85 | $42.68 | ~14× | Bull ref is a stale 1Y high — treat as scenario, not target |
| 2 | MOS | $21.14 | $19.82 | $22.60 | $31.04 | ~7.5× | P/B 0.6× + 4.1% yield compresses real downside |
| 3 | FRMI | $5.94 | $4.47 | $7.26 | $15.00 | ~6× | Binary; MACD flipping positive |
| 4 | AAON | $86.00 | $71.77 | $87.67 | $148.15 | ~4.4× | Fresh 38% earnings beat de-risks the base |
| 5 | WAY | $24.90 | $17.31 | $25.08 | $40.89 | ~2.1× | Best quality; worst reference asymmetry |
| 6 | OSCR | $31.32 | $10.85 | $31.55 | $32.76 | <0.1× | At 52W high — chasing, not entering |
| — | NKE | $39.54 | $40.51 | $40.73 | $77.06 | n/a | Below bear ref; range broken, awaiting Sep 8 checkpoint |
